mapper.insert: insert into knowledge_base(name, description, cover_url, creator_id, is_public, created_at) values (#{name}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{creatorId}, #{isPublic}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.cover_url AS coverUrl, kb.creator_id AS creatorId, kb.is_public AS isPublic, kb.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE(doc.cnt, 0) AS docCount FROM knowledge_base kb LEFT JOIN ( SELECT kb_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM document WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND id NOT IN (SELECT note_id FROM document_embed WHERE note_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY kb_id ) doc ON kb.id = doc.kb_id WHERE kb.creator_id = #{creatorId} AND kb.deleted = 0 ORDER BY kb.created_at DESC
SELECT id, name, description, cover_url AS coverUrl, creator_id AS creatorId, is_public AS isPublic, created_at AS createdAt FROM knowledge_base WHERE id = #{kbId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT km.id AS id, km.kb_id AS kbId, km.user_id AS userId, u.name AS name, km.role AS role, km.joined_at AS joinedAt, km.deleted AS deleted FROM kb_member km INNER JOIN `user` u ON km.user_id = u.id WHERE km.kb_id = #{kbId} AND km.deleted = 0

SELECT d.id, d.title, CAST(d.content AS CHAR) AS content, d.type, d.parent_doc_id AS parentDocId, d.kb_id AS kbId, d.creator_id AS creatorId, d.last_editor_id AS lastEditorId, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM document d WHERE d.kb_id = #{kbId} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.id NOT IN (SELECT note_id FROM document_embed WHERE note_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY d.parent_doc_id, d.id
SELECT role FROM kb_member WHERE kb_id = #{kbId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, description, cover_url AS coverUrl, creator_id AS creatorId, is_public AS isPublic, created_at AS createdAt, deleted FROM knowledge_base WHERE id = #{kbId}
SELECT * FROM knowledge_base WHERE creator_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 1 ORDER BY deleted DESC

SELECT kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.cover_url AS coverUrl, kb.creator_id AS creatorId, kb.is_public AS isPublic, kb.created_at AS createdAt, km.role, COALESCE(doc.cnt, 0) AS docCount FROM kb_member km INNER JOIN knowledge_base kb ON km.kb_id = kb.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT kb_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM document WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND id NOT IN (SELECT note_id FROM document_embed WHERE note_id IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY kb_id ) doc ON kb.id = doc.kb_id WHERE km.user_id = #{userId} AND km.deleted = 0 AND kb.deleted = 0 AND kb.creator_id != #{userId} ORDER BY kb.created_at DESC
